project.name: LEADGEN
project.purpose: Lead generation, website auditing, email deliverability verification, PDF reporting, and outreach operations.
project.status: Audit correctness verified; Email Deliverability Hub, Association Provenance, and Fail-Closed Gates implemented in working tree (HEAD commit c0a5947 on fix/audit-url-sitemap-correctness).

architecture.frontend: React 18 + Vite at frontend/ (Audits page with SEO and Email Deliverability tabs)
architecture.browser_proxy: auditor/auditor/browser/proxy.py — lifecycle-bound HTTP/CONNECT policy proxy; enforces IP policy at TCP-connection time; started/stopped inside BrowserProvider._capture_with_playwright()
architecture.database: PostgreSQL models in backend/app/models.py; additive migrations in backend/migrations/
architecture.lead_discovery: Candidate scoring and context-aware extraction at backend/app/services/lead_discovery_service.py
architecture.template_renderer: Authoritative variable substitution and safe HTML/plain rendering at backend/app/services/template_renderer.py
architecture.outreach: Pre-send gatekeeper, opportunity-backed audit bullets, and sender classification at backend/app/engines/outreach_engine.py

data_flow: lead intake via CSV, keyword/location discovery, or search candidates
context-aware extraction & agency credit detection (quarantines designer credits)
email verification via 6-layer async service (syntax, typo, disposable, DNS/MX, SSRF; optional SMTP disabled by default)
site classification & URL identity separation (requested_url, final_url, canonical_url)
optional browser capture when BROWSER_ENABLED=true with raw-vs-rendered annotation
isolated structured factor results plus mapped Audit columns and audit_lifecycle
Audits.jsx (Website SEO & Email Deliverability tabs) and ReportLab PDF
fail-closed campaign gatekeeper check: assoc in ('matched', 'approved') and not quarantined and valid verification
outbound SMTP sending with sender error classification (auto-pause on 553/535)
IMAP reply triage and activity logging
critical_rules: Runtime code is authoritative; record documentation drift explicitly.
Preserve existing lead, campaign, CRM, outreach, and scraping behavior unless the task authorizes a change.
Use factor_registry.json for all audit-factor changes; 62 factors across 11 groups are canonical.
Browser evidence is disabled by default and never launches at import time.
A browser failure must never affect any of the 62 factor results.
SMTP mailbox and catch-all probing remain permanently optional and disabled by default (smtp_probe_enabled=False).

Campaign and outreach dispatch strictly enforce fail-closed positive allowlist (email_business_association_status in ('matched', 'approved') and not is_quarantined and email_verification_status == 'valid').
Permanent SMTP sender errors (553 5.7.1, 535, 550 quota) must immediately pause campaign and preserve recipient verification state.
Protected original checkout C:\Users\LENOVO\LEADGEN must remain untouched.
Never expose passwords, API keys, tokens, or personal lead data in logs or documents.
known_issues: DOCUMENTATION_DRIFT: archived prose says 55 factors; runtime builds 62.
LIMITATION: Browser evidence is disabled by default; enabled only when BROWSER_ENABLED=true.
LIMITATION: HTTP request duration is not TTFB or Core Web Vitals.
STATUS: Multi-page browser crawl (Phase 3 WS-C) is implemented and verified; lab Core Web Vitals (WS-B) active.

FINDING F1 (low severity): proxy relay (_relay in browser/proxy.py) has only a 30-second idle timeout; no absolute wall-clock cap or byte limit on relay sessions. Blast radius is zero when BROWSER_ENABLED=false.

FINDING F2 (low severity): _handle_plain_http in browser/proxy.py uses rpartition(':') to split host:port; a bare IPv6 literal without brackets would be mis-parsed. Chromium sends well-formed requests so not exploitable in practice, but parse failure is silent.

OBSERVED SENDER ERROR: Hostinger 553 5.7.1 sender address rejected occurs if mailbox credentials mismatch envelope sender or plan is expired; classified as permanent sender failure to auto-pause campaigns.
